🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation (Real Estate, Materials, Industrials leading); Confirmation 2: mixed leadership with Tech and Financials lagging while cyclical/commodity names show strength; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate lead: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +9.74% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +3.04%) ABOVE TREND, DD (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +12.88%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging overall: GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -13.91%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.94% | 1M: -0.62%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.03%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -21.74%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.65% | 1M: -22.65%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.10% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/real estate/materials tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -16.02%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -16.01%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -21.74%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.65% | 1M: -22.65%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +12.05% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.10% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence among large-cap names: AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY, META (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +2.97%) CORRECTION — MAJOR divergence; watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; selective leadership within semis. NVDA (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND, but GOOGL (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -8.03%) BELOW TREND and IBM (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -13.91%) BELOW TREND — sector internal rotation; Tech: 6/19 positive (approx).

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft near-term with dispersion across names. WFC (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -7.32%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -6.03%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — Financials: 4/20 positive (approx).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defense-leaning but mixed on momentum. JNJ (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +14.46%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND, while TMO (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -16.02%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare: 9/15 positive (approx).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to cyclical/value names showing confirmed strength (EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.32% | 1M: +19.27%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap tech/financial names showing persistent weakness (GOOGL, WFC). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt; monitor the major divergence among Big Tech before upping growth exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND, DD (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +12.88%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed by positive news flow. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND — at risk if weakness extends.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (Real Estate: 6/6 positive) and Materials (Materials: 6/7 positive) — strong leadership. BEARISH: Technology (Technology: 6/19 positive) and Financials (Financials: 4/20 positive) — watch for further dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
EQIX: follow hold above recent breakout (1W strength) for continuation; NVDA: watch for follow-through above near-term resistance to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL: monitor 1W downside momentum for trend break while CORRECTION persists.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+80): Applied Materials upbeat outlook; AMAT (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. EQIX (+60): AI-driven results headline; EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. DD (+60): earnings lift; DD (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +12.88%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): FTC scrutiny and Siri AI delays; AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with near-term weakness. AMT (-50): tenant risk headline; AMT (1W: +9.74% | 1M: +8.18%) ABOVE TREND — news/price divergence (distribution risk). F (-80) noted in flow but lacking dual timeframe here; monitor if price reacts further.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt. EQIX (1W: +18.61% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +11.79% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among AAPL (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.08% | 1M: -14.62%) RECOVERY and META (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +2.97%) CORRECTION plus news/price conflicts (e.g., AMT) — watch for confirmation before shifting core exposure.
